answer_1.quote: We aim to evaluate the ability of LLMs to generate such programs when (1) the LLM has access to all the relevant information for generation, encoded in the assistant library documentation, or (2) the LLM selects the relevant primitives by exploring the entire assistant library as a first step prior to program generation.

answer_2.quote: Metrics We report task success. A task is completed if the generated AEP executes without error and all assertions pass in all reference EPs.
